requirement_text: Credentialed Testnet REST target must be exact approved Testnet host
Testnet egress must require TLS and reject non-default ports/userinfo
Ambient proxy configuration must fail closed before credentialed network use
Stdlib transport must not inherit ambient proxies
HTTP redirects must not change Testnet egress destination
Exact request target must be revalidated on each outbound call
Real authenticated Testnet mutation remains externally unverified until exchange observation
OS or infrastructure routing isolation is not claimed by application code
